name: cfg-agent-thinking-off
about: agent.thinking.enabled=false 时整段被丢弃（loadPilotConfig.ts:478），请求与不配一致；对照 cfg-agent-thinking。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: anth/m
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  thinking:
    enabled: false
    budgetTokens: 2048
model:
  providers:
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anth/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            supportsPromptCache: false
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
